spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, uptime_ms
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT time, 1 AS online
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  MAX(time) AS time,
  (MAX(energia_kwh) - MIN(energia_kwh)) AS consumo_hoje
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', NOW())

SELECT time, temperatura_c
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
  AND temperatura_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  time, 
  temperatura_ambiente_c AS "Temp. Ambiente (°C)",
  umidade_pct AS "Umidade Relativa (%)"
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo

SELECT
  $__dateBin(time) AS time,
  AVG(wifi_rssi) AS "Sinal Wi-Fi (dBm)"
FROM telemetria
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time,
  heap_livre_bytes / 1024.0 AS "Heap Livre (KB)"
FROM telemetria
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  date_bin(INTERVAL '5 seconds', time) AS time,
  AVG(corrente_rms_a) AS corrente_rms_a
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  date_bin(INTERVAL '5 seconds', time) AS time,
  AVG(tensao_rms_v) AS tensao_rms_v
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, potencia_w
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT time, energia_kwh
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT time, fator_potencia
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  date_bin(INTERVAL '5 seconds', time) AS time,
  AVG(potencia_w) AS "Ativa (W)",
  AVG(potencia_va) AS "Aparente (VA)",
  SQRT(
    CASE 
      WHEN (AVG(potencia_va) * AVG(potencia_va)) > (AVG(potencia_w) * AVG(potencia_w))
      THEN (AVG(potencia_va) * AVG(potencia_va)) - (AVG(potencia_w) * AVG(potencia_w))
      ELSE 0 
    END
  ) AS "Reativa (VAr)"
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  time, 
  (energia_kwh * ${tarifa:raw}) AS custo_reais
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  MAX(time) AS time,
  CASE 
    WHEN AVG(potencia_w) > 0 
    THEN ((AVG(potencia_w) * 720.0 / 1000.0) * ${tarifa:raw})
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS projecao_mensal_reais
FROM telemetria
WHERE time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo
  AND potencia_w >= 0
